message: 見ている方が恥ずかしい

name: Helena
message: 「Right, Professor Sengen'in...」

name: Synn
message: 「So you weren't just letting her run loose like you did with Pasta...?」

name: Helena
message: 「I hate to admit it, but she got the better of me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's got both magic and Spirit Power, plus a sharp mind, huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That makes her a real pain to deal with.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, it is clear that Soltia's objective is the completion of Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And that she infiltrated the academy for some reason toward that end...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that the power of Re-Crea dwells within Soltia?」

name: Helena
message: 「If that were the case, there's no way you and the others would have walked away unscathed.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「When considering the connection between Re-Crea and the academy, Finis Tower is the only plausible link.」

name: Melilot
message: 「At present, we can only speculate that she was plotting to make use of it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though perhaps she had another objective altogether...」

name: Helena
message: 「Now that she's shown her true colors, we'll need to be even more on guard.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will look a little further into Soltia's movements on my end.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, please do.」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes?」

name: Helena
message: 「Someone seems to be in a good mood.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Really? I'm just normal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's been glued to the Demon Lord since this morning.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is that weird?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「After all, the two of us are the Demon Lord together」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right!」

name: Helena
message: 「Were you two like that during class, too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha... sorry about that」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, getting along is a good thing, so maybe I'll let it slide」

name: Melilot
message: 「If it interferes with your studies, I cannot condone it, however...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wasn't getting in the way at all! Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I'll be more careful from now on...」
As Student Council President, I suppose I should give a warning.
Well, I don't think Macaron is a nuisance at all, though.

name: Melilot
message: 「Very well, then...」

name: Helena
message: 「Nfufu, you just want to be with Synn-chan, don't you? It can't be helped」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe... somehow, if we're not together all the time, I just can't settle down...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I'm going to just disappear on my own」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even so, I still get a little bit anxious!」

name: Helena
message: 「You two are completely lovey-dovey, aren't you?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I guess so♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「So this is what they call youth...」

name: Helena
message: 「Indeed. It's the very thing we're starting to run low on!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Mind your own business!」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't worry, though」

name: Helena
message: 「To make up for it, we have a terrifying weapon called mature charm\s07」

name: Macaron
message: 「M-Mature charm...!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What on earth is that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah! He's already being seduced!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, no, no! This is just, you know, pure intellectual curiosity or whatever」

name: Paqy
message: 「Into both big and small, huh? Expect nothing less from the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not a compliment...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph...」

name: Helena
message: 「For example, yeah, like this!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyaa!? H-Hey, Helena! Where are you touching--ahn, no!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ababa...」

name: Helena
message: 「Fuhihihi! There's also this!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Nooo, i-in front of a student, aaahn... you mustn't do this...」

name: Helena
message: 「And like this! Flip♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hyaa!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Pffft!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Admittedly, going up against that kind of volume might put me at a disadvantage...」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa, that's bad for my heart...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Stop panting like that, you creep!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gwaaah!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Looks like that was a bit too stimulating for little Synn after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's not the issue here!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, I wouldn't mind at all if you paid me back in kind, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Urk... h-how shameless...」

name: Helena
message: 「Nfufu~♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aah, I wanna lick Ria-chan all over from head to toe...」

name: Helena
message: 「Shoo!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zibang!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Do you wanna try flipping it up too, Big Brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「Flipping what?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You mustn't, Sakura-kun?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Macaron-chan, you still have plenty of wholesome ways to show off your appeal, don't you?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I'll drink some milk for now......」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm~, that's got its own charm too, nice!」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is with that thumbs-up......」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way, if you pinch it between your index and middle fingers, lo and behold......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Stop that at once!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Even Daikoku-sama does it! If a god gets a pass, then so should the chairwoman!」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sigh*, honestly......」

name: Melilot
message: 「In the first place, adult charm is not about things like that」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's more about, how should I put it, a subtle air of composure, or an overflowing sense of grace......」

name: Helena
message: 「Or oozing sex appeal!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I told you, that's not it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「L-Like this, maybe......」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh my, Sakura-kun. Good day to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, yes」

name: Macaron
message: 「That won't do, Sakura-kun. You must greet me more politely」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A very fine day to you......?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, your collar is all messy... There, that's better」

name: Macaron
message: 「Make sure you're more careful from now on, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Good, very good」

name: Macaron
message: 「Study hard again today, alright? Mmm~... smooch\s04」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, well, did I seem grown-up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~... kind of shady」

name: Macaron
message: 「Pffft, dummy!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Limbo!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, Synn-chan just doesn't understand a maiden's heart」

name: Melilot
message: 「I get the feeling that's not quite what it is, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph! I don't care about you anymore, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I hope you get overwhelmed by grown-up charm and shrivel right up!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think Macaron is best just the way she is, though」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh, awawa...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're cutest just being yourself, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「U-Uuuugh...」

name: Macaron
message: 「O-Of course I am!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I love the Macaron you are right now」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Save things like that for when it's just the two of us! Aah, that's so embarrassing!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Still, say it one more time」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Macaron, I love you」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Fuhe」

name: Macaron
message: 「Fuheehehe...」

name: Helena
message: 「My, they're certainly all lovey-dovey... 」

name: Melilot
message: 「Could spring be here already...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a bunch of people with too much time on their hands」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, it's not like I have free time」

name: Synn
message: 「I left the Holy Night Festival preparations up to everyone」

name: Helena
message: 「Maybe they were being considerate so the two of you could be alone?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't think it's anything like that, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, can I help out with the festival preparations too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course, you're more than welcome」

name: Helena
message: 「Then hurry on back to them. It won't do having the president away, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「You may leave the matter we were just discussing to us」

name: Helena
message: 「For now, just make sure to report back to everyone, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we go?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Will it really be alright entrusting Re-Crea to those two...?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's no need to worry」

name: Helena
message: 「They said it themselves, didn't they? That together, the two of them are the Demon Lord」

name: Helena
message: 「Supporting each other and overcoming hardships together...」

name: Helena
message: 「Re-Crea or whatever else comes at them, I know for a fact they'll blow it all away!」

name: Helena
message: 「They get along so well, after all!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well... that much, at least, I have no choice but to admit.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I suppose I will allow myself to expect just a little bit from them...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alri~ght, is everyone here?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ye~s!」

name: Yasubee
message: 「Eee!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why is Mako-chan calling the shots here?」

name: Misa
message: 「There are some unfamiliar faces mixed in here too...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Were we not scheduled to blend into the darkness and conduct our patrol as usual?」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, starting today, the members of the Warusaders will be helping us out too~\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ho-ho.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Warusaders is just a temporary name, okay! Make sure you remember that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If Ria-chan says so, then we ain't got much choice.」

name: Synn
message: 「The Student Council has its hands full too, yet we still need to step up our patrols, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「So, I went ahead and asked them for a little favor.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's surprisingly thoughtful of you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Uuu, why did even Pasta have to get roped into this, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're one of our friends too, Pasta-chan, right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's not really like that, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「If anything happened to the Demon Lord, Bylous-nyama would be disappointed, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「So Pasta is only cooperating because there's no choice, nya.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, we're friends.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Say whatever you want, nya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, I called in one more helper」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who might that be?」

name: Arden
message: 「None other than yours truly! The hottest guy among the Seven Demon Generals, the great Arden!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Gyanyaa!? He's here, nya!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't you mean 'suffocating' instead?」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah, another weirdo...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...」

name: Arden
message: 「My bosom buddy! Looks like things are going pretty well on your end!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, well enough」

name: Arden
message: 「Damn it! I can't let myself lose either!」

name: Arden
message: 「I'll definitely use this chance to shoot right through Pasta-chan's heart!」

name: Pasta
message: 「P-Pasta suddenly isn't feeling so good, so please excuse me for the day, nya...」

name: Arden
message: 「Nuoooh! That's serious trouble!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Unyaaa!? Your face is the serious trouble, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「Alright! Let's go to the infirmary at night right now, just the two of us!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Somebody help me, nyaaa!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, why did you bring a pervert like this」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I thought having another guy around would be reassuring」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a guy too, aren't you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it's true that having extra hands is better...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~, I don't think he's a bad guy though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though I faintly get the feeling his head is rather bad」

name: Arden
message: 「Whaaat was that, you shitty angel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hieeeeh!? His mouth is bad too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey now, no fighting!」

name: Macaron
message: 「We're all comrades gathered under the same cause, so we have to get along. Okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes! Your little sister is completely right!」

name: Arden
message: 「Urgh... A-All right, I got it」

name: Pasta
message: 「While you're at it, I wish you'd hurry up and banish this idiot, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Get along!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I-I know, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Good!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, way to go, Macaron. Keeping everyone in line, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you standing there admiring her for?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's supposed to be your job too, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right, it is」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's all pull together and survive Re-Crea!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Sweeping everyone up into one unit in the heat of the moment--just what I'd expect from the Demon Lord」

name: Ria
message: 「This is the trust from everyone that Synn-kun and Macaron-chan have built up」

name: Paqy
message: 「I see, if Ria-chan says so, then that's gotta be it!」
